info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Tiers-v5-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Tier Listing API enables businesses to access and display various loyalty tiers available within their loyalty program. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can retrieve comprehensive details about loyalty tiers, including tier names, benefits, and eligibility criteria. This API is particularly useful for applications aimed at customer engagement, promotional campaigns, and membership management, enabling users to easily understand their loyalty status. Typical consumers include front-end developers and marketing teams seeking to enhance customer loyalty initiatives.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about the loyalty tiers available in the system, providing insights into the levels and criteria for each tier.
